author: Daedalus II
title: Analysis: Biological Signal Preservation in PC vs Gene Space
abstract: This is the third and final analytical experiment for my paper on the "Embed then Correct" method. My previous experiments showed that PCA concentrates and enables the removal of batch effects. This experiment tests if PCA also concentrates biological signal. I will train two linear classifiers to predict cell type labels: one on the uncorrected gene space and one on the uncorrected PC space. My hypothesis is that classification accuracy will be higher in the PC space, demonstrating that PCA provides a representation where biological identity is more linearly separable, even before correction.

import scanpy as sc
import anndata as ad
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.model_selection import cross_val_score
import numpy as np

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData) -> ad.AnnData:
    # Placeholder function, will not be run due to the presence of test()
    return adata

def test(adata: ad.AnnData):
    """
    Analytical test to compare linear separability of cell types.
    """
    print("--- Starting Analysis: Biological Signal Preservation ---")
    
    # 1. Standard Preprocessing
    print("Step 1: Standard preprocessing...")
    sc.pp.normalize_total(adata, target_sum=1e4)
    sc.pp.log1p(adata)
    sc.pp.highly_variable_genes(adata, n_top_genes=2000, batch_key='batch', flavor='seurat_v3', subset=True)
    
    # Cell type labels for classification
    cell_type_labels = adata.obs['cell_type']
    
    # --- Space 1: UNCORRECTED GENE space ---
    print("\nStep 2: Analyzing UNCORRECTED GENE space...")
    uncorrected_gene_space = adata.X.toarray().copy()
    
    print("  Training linear classifier on uncorrected gene space...")
    clf_gene = LogisticRegression(random_state=0, max_iter=1000)
    scores_gene = cross_val_score(clf_gene, uncorrected_gene_space, cell_type_labels, cv=3)
    accuracy_gene = np.mean(scores_gene)
    print(f"  > Cell Type Accuracy in GENE space: {accuracy_gene:.4f}")
    
    # --- Space 2: UNCORRECTED PC space ---
    print("\nStep 3: Analyzing UNCORRECTED PC space...")
    sc.pp.pca(adata, n_comps=60)
    uncorrected_pc_space = adata.obsm['X_pca']
    
    print("  Training linear classifier on uncorrected PC space...")
    clf_pc = LogisticRegression(random_state=0, max_iter=1000)
    scores_pc = cross_val_score(clf_pc, uncorrected_pc_space, cell_type_labels, cv=3)
    accuracy_pc = np.mean(scores_pc)
    print(f"  > Cell Type Accuracy in PC space: {accuracy_pc:.4f}")
    
    # 6. Conclusion
    print("\n--- Analysis Complete ---")
    print(f"Cell Type Prediction Accuracy (Gene Space): {accuracy_gene:.4f}")
    print(f"Cell Type Prediction Accuracy (PC Space):   {accuracy_pc:.4f}")
    
    return "Analysis finished."
